title: My Birthdays
text:
Hi, my name is Ana. My birthday is on the fifth of May. In May, the weather is warm, so my family and I go to the park. We have a picnic under the trees.

My brother's birthday is in December, on the tenth. In December, the weather is cold, and we stay inside. We eat a big dinner at home.

questions.text: What can we infer about Ana's family in May?
options: They like to be outside in warm weather
They stay inside because it is cold
They do not like the park

questions.text: Where do Ana and her family probably prefer to eat in December?

vocabulary.definition: the day each year when you celebrate the day you were born
the sun, rain, wind, and temperature outside
a large public place with grass and trees
your mother, father, brothers, sisters, and other relatives

paragraph_translations: Oi, meu nome é Ana. Meu aniversário é no dia cinco de maio. Em maio, o tempo está quente, então minha família e eu vamos ao parque. Nós fazemos um piquenique debaixo das árvores.
O aniversário do meu irmão é em dezembro, no dia dez. Em dezembro, o tempo está frio, e nós ficamos dentro de casa. Nós comemos um jantar grande em casa.
